acceptance.given: A Replay Result reports success after replay execution of the declared command.

oracle.expected: The structured Replay Result verification output contains a distinct passing command-verification record bound to the declared native command identity, independently of the other verification fields.
forbidden: The successful Replay Result lacks an independent command-verification outcome.
Command verification is inferred only from an aggregate success flag or another verification category.
The command-verification record is bound to a different command identity.
oracle.observable: The replay test/validator output exposes command verification as its own named result with pass status and matching command identity evidence.

acceptance.then: The command is independently verified for the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: Run the Toolchain replay test suite against a successful Replay Result and inspect its structured verification output.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use the existing replay test selector in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_package_replay.py and construct a successful Replay Result whose command-verification record is absent, aggregate-only, or bound to a different command identity; the validator must reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure every successful Replay Result emits and validates a separate command-verification outcome bound to the declared native command identity, rather than deriving command verification from aggregate success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing Replay Result schema and successful replay behavior; rollback only the added independent command-verification emission and check if compatibility validation fails.

slice_hint.state_transition: A successful Replay Result transitions from command verification unestablished to command verification independently observed and passed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay validation passes only when the successful Replay Result contains a distinct passing command-verification record with the declared native command identity; missing, aggregate-only, or mismatched command verification fails validation.

acceptance.given: 在矩阵汇总评估输入中，至少一个被引用的矩阵证据被标记为复制内容，且其内容身份或来源与声明的原始证据不一致。

oracle.expected: 汇总结果状态为无效，并记录复制矩阵证据触发的 FR-8 约束拒绝。
forbidden: 复制矩阵证据被接受为有效证据
仅因存在其他通过证据而忽略复制证据
oracle.observable: 结构化汇总结果的状态字段为 invalid/无效，且拒绝原因或约束标识包含复制矩阵证据与 FR-8。

acceptance.then: 验证器读取汇总输入及证据身份声明，检测复制证据并完成 FR-8 约束判定后输出无效汇总。
acceptance.when: 执行矩阵证据汇总验证/评估命令并检查其结构化结果。

failure_intents.selector_intent: 使用矩阵汇总验证器的负向测试夹具，将矩阵证据内容替换为与声明身份不一致的复制内容；断言验证器拒绝该汇总并返回 invalid，而不是接受为 valid。

slice_hint.behavior_change: 在 Toolchain 矩阵汇总判定中实施 FR-8 约束：任何被识别为复制内容的矩阵证据都会使汇总结果无效；实现验证证据内容身份与声明来源的一致性，并在拒绝结果中保留可审计的 FR-8 原因。

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: 仅回滚 FR-8 复制证据判定逻辑及其测试；不得改变现有矩阵证据格式、汇总结果字段或其他 FR-8 无效条件。

slice_hint.state_transition: 汇总计算状态从“正在基于矩阵证据计算汇总结果”转为“汇总结果被判定为无效”，当输入证据被判定为复制内容时。
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: 矩阵汇总验证命令执行完成，结构化结果明确包含复制证据拒绝和 FR-8，状态为 invalid，且不存在 valid 结论。

acceptance.given: For each of the six materially distinct Matrix Cases, a Candidate subject is selected with a recorded identity or content digest before execution and the case execution harness is available.

oracle.expected: The verification run reports six case-scoped execution records; each record includes the pre-execution Candidate identity or content digest and a matching post-execution digest, with all six Matrix Case identifiers present.
forbidden: Any pre- and post-execution Candidate digest differs within a Matrix Case.
A Candidate subject is replaced, mutated, or selected from a different identity during execution.
Any of the six Matrix Cases lacks Candidate-subject execution evidence.
oracle.observable: A machine-readable six-case evidence result from the Toolchain Matrix Case execution and validation harness, showing case ID, Candidate identity or content before execution, Candidate identity or content after execution, and equality for every case.

acceptance.then: Every Matrix Case has execution evidence demonstrating that its selected Candidate subject remained immutable throughout execution.
acceptance.when: Run the Toolchain Matrix Case execution harness for all six cases, then validate the emitted per-case identity or content comparisons.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the six-case Matrix Case harness against a Candidate fixture deliberately mutated or replaced between its pre- and post-execution identity or content captures; the validator must fail the immutability comparison.
Execute the six-case validation with one Matrix Case omitted from Candidate-subject execution evidence; the validator must fail closed for incomplete six-case coverage.

affected_subjects: Candidate subject execution across all six Matrix Cases
slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure the Toolchain Matrix Case execution path captures each Candidate subject identity or content before and after execution, rejects mutation or replacement, and emits attributable evidence for all six cases.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Candidate identity, process execution, and case-evidence schemas; rollback only the added pre/post immutability capture and six-case coverage validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Selected Candidate subject with pre-execution identity or content -> six Matrix Case executions -> post-execution identity or content comparison -> immutable Candidate evidence or fail-closed mutation or missing-case result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For every one of the six Matrix Cases, Candidate pre- and post-execution identity or content digests are equal and attributable in the emitted evidence; otherwise validation fails.

acceptance.given: A non-empty Consumer Manifest and its applicable route-transition definitions are loaded by the toolchain replay evaluator, with rollback baseline data available for the same manifest entries.

oracle.expected: The evaluator executes every applicable route transition for every Consumer Manifest entry, records completion and post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observations per entry, and reports 100% completion with no skipped or incomplete applicable transitions.
forbidden: Any applicable route transition is skipped, incomplete, or lacks a post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation.
The reported completion percentage is below 100% or cannot be reconciled to the complete non-empty Consumer Manifest.
oracle.observable: A machine-readable route-transition evaluation result contains one completed record for each manifest entry and applicable transition, includes rollback baseline observations, and its aggregate completion count equals the manifest transition count.

acceptance.then: The replay evaluator has demonstrated complete route-transition execution and rollback-baseline observation for the non-empty Consumer Manifest.
acceptance.when: After the toolchain replay/evaluation command has executed all applicable route transitions and completed rollback verification for the manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the route-transition evaluation against a non-empty Consumer Manifest fixture with at least one applicable transition intentionally omitted or marked incomplete; the evaluator must fail or report completion below 100%.
Run the manifest evaluation with a transition result missing its post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; validation must reject the result as incomplete.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend or verify the Toolchain replay evaluator so each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry is reconciled to every applicable route transition, each transition records completion and post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline evidence, and aggregate success is emitted only when all applicable transitions complete.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing manifest and replay result schemas; additions must remain backward-compatible and rollback must restore prior baseline observations for every manifest entry.

slice_hint.state_transition: non-empty manifest loaded -> applicable transitions enumerated -> each transition executed -> rollback baseline observed -> aggregate completion reconciled -> success or failure emitted
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For every Consumer Manifest entry, all applicable route transitions have completed and each has a recorded post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; aggregate completed transitions equals aggregate applicable transitions (100%).
